# cozystack_tenant_secret (Ephemeral Resource)

A TenantSecret's data, fetched at apply time without being stored in state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) TenantSecret name.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret values keyed by name.
- `type` (String) Secret type.
